# AuthCost

> Auth and identity list prices (base + MAU/MRU + SSO), 25 plan rows, 25 verified, 10 vendors, checked 2026-10-31.

## Methodology
Prices from each vendor's own pricing page only. Verified rows were read on the date shown. We never invent a price. Details: https://authcost.pages.dev/methodology

## Data (CC BY 4.0 — attribute "AuthCost" + link https://authcost.pages.dev/)

- [Changes JSON](https://authcost.pages.dev/api/changes.json)
- [Full dump](https://authcost.pages.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Assumptions
- SSO results for Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform (billed per SSO user) assume 200 SSO users per connection; sensitivity at 1000 and 2000: https://authcost.pages.dev/methodology#sso-users
- Headline: At 100k users, Clerk Pro lists $1,025/mo; WorkOS AuthKit, the cheapest verified plan that includes MFA at that size, lists $0 ($12,300/yr less).
